title: pathwaycom/llm-app
friendlyTitle: Pathway templates for AI that reads live business data
summary: Pathway’s LLM App repository provides ready-to-run templates for RAG, enterprise search and live-data AI pipelines. Its connectors cover sources including SharePoint, Google Drive, S3, Kafka, PostgreSQL and real-time APIs, and the project has more than 59,000 stars.
friendlySummary: This project contains ready-made examples for search and question-answering across files, databases and live data feeds.
whyItMatters: Teams can use the Docker-friendly templates to prototype retrieval systems that stay synchronized with changing business data rather than relying on occasional static re-indexing.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you build an AI search tool that stays updated when your company data changes.
